items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Buddy came back here. But after I came back here then we got together and that's how we happened to go to Florida, to Pensacola, Florida, got the band up together again

ctx.x: What were some of Buddy Petit's tunes?
Boy, he played all of these tunes, all of these Dixon Van Tune, Heiser, the clarinet, Marmalade, Tin Roof Blues. Did he make up any numbers? Tin Roof Blues was Buddy's. Buddy made up Tin Roof Blues.
Well it had a special name then though.
